lines.zh: 我从山脊上滑下来，翼膜张开。
lines.en: I slip down the ridge, wings spread.

lines.zh: 我走在恶地的碎石上，爪子很稳。
lines.en: I walk the badland scree, my claws sure.

lines.zh: 我收起翅膀，用两条腿走。
lines.en: I fold my wings and walk on two legs.
Each step carries me a long way.
I walk the cliff's edge.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，碎石往下滚。
lines.en: Where I pass, gravel trickles down.
I climb toward the high ground.
I turn to look down the valley.

lines.zh: 我的羽冠在风里向后飘。
lines.en: My crest streams back in the wind.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，翅膀一直半张。
lines.en: I walk slowly, wings half open.
I clear the fissure and land lightly.

lines.zh: 我在山脊上停下来喘气。
lines.en: I stop on the ridge to breathe.

lines.zh: 我抬高腿，跨过一道裂缝。
lines.en: I lift a leg over a fissure.

lines.zh: 我一直朝最高的地方走。
lines.en: I keep climbing toward the highest point.

lines.zh: 我站在尖峰上，翅尖轻颤。
lines.en: I stand on the peak, wingtips trembling.

lines.zh: 我把爪尖在岩上磨了磨。
lines.en: I whet my talons on the stone.

lines.zh: 翼膜一撑，我又收回身侧。
lines.en: My wing membrane flexes and folds back.
I am listening to the wind up here.

lines.zh: 我的羽冠被风吹得往后。
lines.en: The wind pushes my crest back.

lines.zh: 我换脚站，翼尖扫过岩面。
lines.en: I shift feet, my wingtip brushing the rock.
I count the stones in the valley.
I am watching the land below the clouds.
I let out a long cry.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀上的石屑。
lines.en: I shake the grit from my wings.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，稳住重心。
lines.en: I lower myself and steady.

lines.zh: 我停在那里，像一座雕像。
lines.en: I hold there like a statue.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把翅膀收到身侧。
lines.en: I slowly fold my wings at my sides.
I watch the distance a while longer.
I look down at you from above.
You came a long way to get here.
I fold my wings and land on the rock.
I tilt my head and study your stance.

lines.zh: 你的气很稳，我感觉得到。
lines.en: Your ki is steady. I can feel it.
I take one slow step toward you.
I extend one wing.
I have no wish to be your enemy.

lines.zh: 你的轮廓已经刻进我记忆。
lines.en: Your outline is cut into my memory.
I crouch to your level.
I fold my wings and stand tall.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，让你有空间。
lines.en: I give half a step to give you room.

lines.zh: 我发出一声很轻的鸣叫。
lines.en: I give a soft cry.
I tilt my head and study your hands.
I look down to see what you do first.
I use my wing to break the wind.
I step back, one wing askew.
I look down to find the wound.
I give a short cry.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀收起来护住身体。
lines.en: I fold my wings to shield myself.
I slowly steady myself.
I let my head sink.
I shake and my plumage scatters.
I retreat toward the rock's edge.
My plumage is in disarray; I shake it out.

lines.zh: 我胸口起伏，风灌进羽毛。
lines.en: My chest heaves; wind gets into my feathers.
I accept this.
I lower my head and take it in my beak.
I shake my head and swallow it down.
Not worth a flight for me.

lines.zh: 我用喙碰了碰你的掌心。
lines.en: I touch my beak to your palm.
I stretch my neck again.
I offer a claw.

lines.zh: 我撕下一小块，其余踩住。
lines.en: I tear off a piece and stand on the rest.

lines.zh: 我朝你的手靠近了一点。
lines.en: I come a little nearer your hand.
I nod once, which is thanks.
I draw my talons in a little.
I withdraw to the rock.
A tuft of my crest is knocked awry.
I spread both wings to brace.
The bump turns me half a step aside.
The impact carries you off course.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，翅膀擦过你。
lines.en: I turn aside; my wing brushes you.

lines.zh: 我低头看被碰到的那侧。
lines.en: I look down at the side that was hit.
I am not provoked in the slightest.
I lift a foot and shift my stance.
I settle back to the ground.
I dip my head to you.

lines.zh: 另一位从更高的山脊上下来。
lines.en: Another descends from a higher ridge.

lines.zh: 我们并肩而立，翼缘相贴。
lines.en: We stand abreast, wing edges touching.

lines.zh: 我把找到的东西推过去。
lines.en: I push what I found toward it.
It smooths my crest.
We cry into the valley together.

lines.zh: 它飞在我前面，羽色更暗。
lines.en: It flies ahead of me, its plumage darker.

lines.zh: 我们一同飞了半圈山脊。
lines.en: We fly half a circuit of the ridge together.

lines.zh: 我们在同一块岩上落下。
lines.en: We land on the same rock.

lines.zh: 它站在左边，我站在右边。
lines.en: It takes the left. I take the right.

lines.zh: 我们一起看着远处的云。
lines.en: We watch the distant clouds together.
I hook it with a talon.
I take it and turn it over.
I look it over and set it down.
It is not what I want.
I tuck it into a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 我把它丢在崖边的凹处。
lines.en: I drop it into a hollow by the cliff.
I open my claws and let it fall.
I set it beside your hand.

lines.zh: 我用爪子把它翻了个面。
lines.en: I turn it over with a talon.
I will keep this for myself.
I have turned my head to you.

lines.zh: 我翅膀扇起的风先到你头顶。
lines.en: The wind from my wings reaches your head first.
I leap from the rock.
I begin gathering power.

lines.zh: 落点定在你背后的空地。
lines.en: My landing spot is the open ground behind you.
I have your bearing locked.
I am in no hurry. You will not get far.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边转圈。
lines.en: My shadow circles at your feet.
My shadow falls on you.
This time I use a technique.
I fold my wings to drop.
Your time is running short.
I circle above your head.

lines.zh: 你走哪条路都躲不开我的眼。
lines.en: Whichever way you go, my eyes find you.

lines.zh: 我一顿一顿地压低高度。
lines.en: I drop lower in stages.
You shoot; I bank away.
I land behind you.
I have not touched the ground.

lines.zh: 我的气流把尘土卷起来。
lines.en: My wake stirs up the dust.

lines.zh: 我借着热气流又高了一层。
lines.en: A thermal lifts me another layer.
Are you counting my circles.
I am one dive away.
My circles draw tighter and tighter.
I have you against the stone wall.

lines.zh: 我从上方砸下来，爪子先到。
lines.en: I come down from above, talons first.
One beat of my wings knocks you down.
My beak raps your shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 我把气聚在爪上，抓下去。
lines.en: I gather power in my claws and strike.
My talons close on gravel.

lines.zh: 我绕着你飞，掀起的风打在你身上。
lines.en: I fly around you; my wind strikes you.

lines.zh: 翅膀收起，我斜着扎下来。
lines.en: Wings tucked, I stoop in at an angle.
You block once and go far back.
I spring into the air again.
My claws are still open.
The blow throws up gravel.
I land beside you.

lines.zh: 我先在上风处收住翅膀。
lines.en: I check my wings on the upwind side first.
I fold my wings first and steady.
The wind is good here.
I glance up at the peaks.
I shake the loose dust off my wings.
I cry into the valley.
I walk slowly to the rock's edge.
I know this place is high.
I turn toward the rising air.
I start along the ridge.
I drop out of a cloud's shadow onto the rock.

lines.zh: 我落在最高的那根岩柱上。
lines.en: I land on the tallest pillar.
I crouch and rise again.
I look your way.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的翼膜，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my wing membrane; I beat at it.
I hit the rock with a wing bent.

lines.zh: 水漫上来，我的腿使不上劲。
lines.en: Water rises; my legs will not answer.
The blast slams me into the cliff.
An arrow pierces my membrane.
That light presses my ki down.
Too hungry to open my wings.

lines.zh: 雷打在峰顶，我摔了下来。
lines.en: Lightning hits the peak; I fall.
There are no air currents in the dark.
